title: recording.completed
description: The pipeline finished; the recording is ready to view. run_id identifies THIS pipeline run and attempt counts the runs of this recording (1 = the first processing, +1 per reprocess): the same recording can be run again, so a metering/billing consumer keys its idempotency on recording_id + run_id — recording_id alone makes every re-run free. Optional in the schema so payloads emitted before run identity existed still validate; the driver always sends both.
